author: First Council of Constantinople (381)
citation_system: art. n (Greek incipit): truth-core's twelve-article division of the Greek text, following the creed's own clause structure (see notes); Denzinger-Schönmetzer cites the whole creed as DS 150
notes: There is no CTS or SCTA identifier for the creed, so the work and edition identifier is the Corpus Coranicum record (TUK 47) whose TEI export is pinned. The pinned witness is the Greek transcription of the creed in the BBAW Corpus Coranicum TEI export (telota/corpus-coranicum-tei), whose bibliography names the critical edition G. L. Dossetti, Il simbolo di Nicea e di Costantinopoli, Rome 1967, pp. 244-251. The repository README licenses the dataset CC BY-SA 4.0 (© Berlin-Brandenburgische Akademie der Wissenschaften 2024); only hashes, locators and short incipits are committed. The witness text is the `<div type="transcription" xml:lang="ell">`; the file also carries a German translation, which adds the Latin Filioque, and a Quran-studies summary. Neither is witness text, and materialization of the whole file includes both, so read only the Greek division. Article division used for claims: 1 one God the Father almighty, maker of heaven and earth; 2 one Lord Jesus Christ, only-begotten Son, consubstantial, through whom all things were made; 3 came down for our salvation, incarnate of the Holy Spirit and the Virgin Mary, became man; 4 crucified under Pontius Pilate, suffered, buried; 5 rose on the third day according to the Scriptures; 6 ascended, seated at the right hand of the Father; 7 will come again in glory to judge the living and the dead, kingdom without end; 8 the Holy Spirit, Lord and giver of life, proceeding from the Father, co-worshipped and co-glorified, who spoke through the prophets; 9 one, holy, catholic and apostolic Church; 10 one baptism for the forgiveness of sins; 11 resurrection of the dead; 12 life of the world to come. The division follows the creed's participial and prepositional clauses and is a modeling choice, not a conciliar numbering.
